post.caption:
Your blood vessels would wrap around Earth twice. The pump driving them is the size of your fist, beats about 100,000 times a day, moves around 7,500 litres, and sends a blood cell on a full circuit of your body in under a minute. The strangest part is that it does not need your brain at all. It has its own electrical pacemaker, and a heart removed from the body and given oxygen keeps beating on its own.
